evidence.structure: Round-headed figures with white scarf, red coat with belt, arms gripping the staff, dark boots; the torso is a plain box.
evidence.scale: About two blocks tall and roughly a fifth of the panel height; they do not dominate the terrain.
evidence.camera: Platforms, arches, the column and cliffs share consistent 2:1 isometric diagonals.
evidence.line: Heavy dark outlines, mostly even weight with a little wobble.
evidence.finish: Watercolour washes with paper grain and slight off-register colour.
evidence.personality: Wide hat, staff and scarf give a nameable silhouette, but the three figures are identical.
evidence.fit: Warm ochre, green and blue palette matches the terrains.

source: fresh reviewer, blind, rubric v2 (scale up to two blocks)
